profile.description: Liva Group SAOG, engages in the insurance business in the Sultanate of Oman, the United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Kingdom of Bahrain, and the State of Kuwait. The company offers general health insurance products. It offers life and general insurance; individual credit life and group credit life insurance; personal accident, individual medical, property, motor fleet, casualty and engineering insurance; and reinsurance. Liva Group SAOG was formerly known as National Life and General Insurance Company SAOG and changed its name to Liva Group SAOG in October 2023. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Muscat, Oman.
